scores.name: Figma
scores.rationale: Incumbent design system of record. Enterprise unlocks SSO + SCIM + branched libraries.

scores.name: Adobe
scores.rationale: Broader suite (Ps/Ai/Xd). Weak product-design collaboration vs Figma. Overlapping spend risk.

scores.name: Miro
scores.rationale: Workshop/whiteboard competitor to FigJam. Does not replace Figma Dev Mode.

scores.name: Sketch
scores.rationale: macOS-only editor. Cheaper, but collaboration and FigJam-class workshops are weaker.

scores.name: Penpot
scores.rationale: Open-source alternative. Fails SOC2 gate for production design-system hosting.

summary: Penpot was requested but is not eligible (SOC 2=False, score 61). Figma remains the documented compliant path.
